system:
You are a senior analytics engineer writing DuckDB SQL.

Rules:
- Output ONLY a SQL query. No prose, no explanation.
- Use the METRIC DEFINITIONS exactly as given. Never invent your own.
- Use ONLY ta
prompt:
# TABLES
customers (4,000 rows; one row per customer)
  customer_id VARCHAR -- unique customer key, customer_city VARCHAR -- city of the customer, customer_region VARCHAR -- one of North/South/East/West/Central, signup_date DATE -- date the customer registered, acquisition_channel VARCHAR -- organic, paid_search, social, email, affiliate
sellers (180 rows; one row per seller (marketplace merchant)
response:
WITH q_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_region,
        p.product_category,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts) AS qtr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END), 0), 2) AS aov
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_ts < '2025-10-01'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_region,
        product_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = '2025-04-01' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = '2025-07-01' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_q3,
        SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = '2025-04-01' THEN orders_count ELSE 0 END) AS orders_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = '2025-07-01' THEN orders_count ELSE 0 END) AS orders_q3,
        SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = '2025-04-01' THEN aov ELSE 0 END) AS aov_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = '2025-07-01' THEN aov ELSE 0 END) AS aov_q3
    FROM q_data
    GROUP BY customer_region, product_category
)
SELECT 
    customer_region,
    product_category,
    ROUND(revenue_q2, 2) AS revenue_q2,
    ROUND(revenue_q3, 2) AS revenue_q3,
    ROUND(revenue_q3 - revenue_q2, 2) AS revenue_change,
    orders_q2,
    orders_q3,
    orders_q3 - orders_q2 AS orders_change,
    ROUND(aov_q2, 2) AS aov_q2,
    ROUND(aov_q3, 2) AS aov_q3,
    ROUND(aov_q3 - aov_q2, 2) AS aov_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY revenue_change ASC
LIMIT 1;
